stock.description: Xuan Wu Cloud Technology Holdings Limited functions as an investment holding entity, providing advanced customer relationship management (CRM) services across the People's Republic of China. The company's portfolio includes both CRM platform-as-a-service (PaaS) and software-as-a-service (SaaS) offerings. It primarily serves various sectors, such as fast-moving consumer goods (FMCG), financial services, technology, media, and telecommunications (TMT), as well as governmental and related organizations. Established in 2010, the firm's headquarters are located in Guangzhou, within the People's Republic of China.
